base.note: v1.5.8 is a focused frontend patch over the deployed v1.5.7 baseline.

changes.DASHBOARD_NEXT_TASK_FIRST_158: Moves Next task / Continue session immediately below HOY and before academic/adaptive priority-reading alerts; technical blocking banners remain above.
changes.HISTORY_DAY_REVIEW_158: Adds filtered review of unique questions already answered on the selected date: Todas, Erradas, Duda ?, No sé, Lentas and Revisar.
changes.READ_ONLY_REVIEW_158: History day review is an ephemeral reviewContext only; opening/navigating it creates no practice_session, attempt, memory update, outbox/recovery operation or automatic note/flag.
changes.LATEST_QUALIFYING_ATTEMPT_158: Each question appears once per filter and displays the latest attempt from that date that qualifies for the selected filter; a wrong-then-correct question remains available in Erradas.
changes.SLOW_SEMANTICS_158: Lentas reuses the existing speed rule: correct, not uncertain, not timed out, and response_time_ms above the stored/effective target.
changes.DOUBT_READ_ONLY_158: The day-review view suppresses interactive ? controls so reviewing cannot mutate was_uncertain/question_memory_state; existing doubt is shown as read-only evidence.
changes.EXPLICIT_ACTIONS_PRESERVED_158: Existing explicit Añadir nota and Revisar pregunta actions remain available inside review; they are never triggered by navigation.
changes.SEMANTICS_PRESERVED_158: No changes to scheduler, memory algorithm, Supabase schema, dataset, taxonomy, PT409/recovery or protected session files.

supabase_migration.note: No migration. v1.5.8 is frontend-only and reads existing attempts/flags.
